title: CodeRant Meetup — Farewell Gathering
description: The second CodeRant meetup was a memorable evening dedicated to bidding farewell to two beloved senior members who were preparing to leave Malaysia and return home. Held from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Pak Punjab, Jalan Ipoh, the gathering brought together community members for meaningful conversations, laughter, and lasting connections. Beyond technology and software engineering, members exchanged perspectives on life, personal experiences, and future aspirations. The evening was another reminder of the value of learning, friendship, and belonging to a supportive professional community.
location: Pak Punjab, Jalan Ipoh, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

title: CodeRant Meetup & Eid Reunion 2026
description: Alhamdulillah, CodeRant successfully hosted its first meetup and Eid reunion of 2026 at Sunway Geo, Malaysia, from 1:00 PM to 4:30 PM. The gathering brought together Bangladeshi technology professionals working across Malaysia for an afternoon of introductions, experience sharing, idea exchange, and discussions about future community initiatives. The spontaneous participation of both new and existing members created a warm, vibrant, and inspiring atmosphere. The event strengthened professional relationships and celebrated the spirit of community. Heartfelt thanks to everyone who attended, and we look forward to welcoming more members at future gatherings.

title: Tech Session: Building a Successful Remote Career
description: CodeRant hosted a technical knowledge-sharing session on building a successful remote career, featuring Modasser Billah, Backend Lead at Doist. The session provided an opportunity for technology professionals to learn about remote work, career development, and the experiences of working in distributed teams. Members gained insights into navigating the remote technology job market and developing the skills needed to build a sustainable international career.

title: CodeRant Community Meetup — October 2025
description: CodeRant hosted another meetup for Bangladeshi technology professionals working across Malaysia. Approximately 40 professionals from various reputable companies attended the gathering in Kuala Lumpur. The event was honoured by the presence of Arafat Rahman, a former president of CodeRant who travelled from Turkey. Alongside dinner and informal technology discussions, the community celebrated the achievements of participants in a CodeRant-organised badminton tournament and presented awards to the winners and their representatives. The evening combined professional networking, friendly competition, and community spirit.

title: Resume Review & Mock Interview Workshop
description: A practical online workshop where experienced community members review resumes, share job application strategies, and conduct mock interviews for aspiring technology professionals. Participants will receive constructive feedback and guidance to help them prepare for future career opportunities.

title: CodeRant Annual Tech Meetup 2026
description: A proposed annual gathering of Bangladeshi technology professionals in Malaysia. The planned programme includes networking, lightning talks, professional experience sharing, and community recognition. This demonstration event showcases how a flagship CodeRant community gathering could be presented on the website.

title: Cloud Native Malaysia: AWS Deep Dive
description: A proposed technical workshop exploring cloud-native architecture, AWS services, scalability, deployment strategies, and cost optimisation.
